name: Canopy shade dense (front, full)
prompt:
A soft, natural pattern of dappled shade — the mottled shadow that sunlight casts through overhead a dense forest canopy onto a flat, plain surface.
a dense, finely broken mottle of shade with small bright gaps.
Only the cast shadow itself: soft-edged dark, semi-transparent blotches with gaps of open light between them, organic and irregular, exactly the way real dappled sunlight falls on the ground.
NOT the a dense forest canopy themselves and no objects at all — only the shadow they cast, carried in the alpha channel on a fully transparent background so it can be laid over any photo.
No text, no watermark, no caption, no border, no frame, no sticker sheet, no collage.
negative_prompt: leaves, branches, twigs, foliage, plants, tree, grass blades themselves, objects, subject, creature, animal, person, bright, glowing, light source, sunbeam, sky, lens flare, colorful, saturated, green, scenery, landscape, photograph of a forest, text, watermark, border, frame, white background, grey background, opaque background, solid background
curation_note: Discarded on owner review 2026-07-28. Tier-A QC auto-approved these, but QC measures geometry only and cannot see subject: the template asked for cast shadow and the negative_prompt excluded leaves/foliage/green/saturated, yet the batch came back as saturated green foliage. branch-shadow additionally measured 21.6% transparent (the shipped procedural dapple set is 55-66%), so it renders as a near-opaque tile rather than an overlay. Re-roll the template rather than re-promoting these.
